name: barbute
_design_note: F35-60 medium head slot. Segmented spangenhelm with hinged cheek guards. Material is the variation axis — name retained for canon.
lore_template: Armorers of Italy took the shape of the {material_name} barbute from the helms of ancient Greece. It is a deep helm of one piece with a T-shaped opening for eyes and mouth, and it guards the cheeks and neck without shutting up the ears.
